Motion UI expressive controls adapt visual interaction patterns and selected CSS from Lucian UX/UI Prompt #002, #013, #018, by Seokwoooo, MIT License. Reference: https://github.com/Seokwoooo/lucian-uxui-prompt . Local user-provided copies were reviewed. Host actions, persistence, React controls and truthful result feedback are implemented by Motion UI. No simulated download, clipboard success or glass materials are included.
